newsitem.title: USA: DuPont power unit gets Pennsylvania license.
newsitem.headline: DuPont power unit gets Pennsylvania license.

text.p: DuPont Power Marketing Inc said it has been granted a license to sell electricity by the Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission and plans to take part in the state's pilot programs aimed at allowing customer choice in the selection of electricity providers.
"These programs present a two-way opportunity for DuPont," said DuPont Power Marketing Vice President Natalie Oakes.
"Not only are we a supplier of electricity, we are also a large industrial customer in Pennsylvania, where we operate three facilities."
President Gordon Goodman said the DuPont subsidiary has more than doubled its volumes since year-end 1996, moving more than 6 million megawatts hours of power this month.
